newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle $106/dressed, up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle $106/dressed, up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were fully $1.00 per cwt higher on a live basis, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1300 lbs 65.00-66.00, few 66.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 65.00-66.00, few 66.50.
On a carcass basis, steers and heifers $2.00 higher.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 105.00-106.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 105.00-106.00. Reported sales for Tuesday - 3,200 Week to Date - 9,500
